blocks.title: Project logistics support for heavy and complex cargo
blocks.body: Kenya Tradex delivers end-to-end project logistics solutions for heavy lift, oversized, and time-critical cargo across East Africa. We manage every stage from port of entry to final installation site, with specialized handling for mining equipment, oil and gas infrastructure, wind turbines, and industrial machinery.
items: Heavy Lift Cargo (20-200+ tons) – Transformers, generators, industrial presses
Oversized & Out-of-Gauge Cargo – Route surveys and permit acquisition
Mining Equipment Logistics – Excavators, crushers, conveyors, drilling rigs
Oil & Gas Logistics – Pipelines, pressure vessels, refinery components
Wind Turbine & Renewable Energy Transport – Blades, towers, nacelles
Industrial Machinery Relocation – Plant moves and factory setup
Turnkey Project Management – From port of entry to final installation

blocks.title: Major Project Destinations
items: Kenya: Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Eldoret, Turkana (oil fields)
Uganda: Kampala, Jinja, Hoima (oil exploration), Kasese (mining)
Rwanda: Kigali, Rwinkwavu (mining), Lake Kivu (methane gas)
DRC: Lubumbashi (copper/cobalt), Kolwezi, Goma
South Sudan: Juba, Bentiu, Malakal (oil infrastructure)
Tanzania: Dar es Salaam, Mtwara (energy corridor)

blocks.title: How the project logistics process works
items: Step 1: Project assessment and route survey
Step 2: Permit acquisition and customs pre-clearance
Step 3: Ocean freight coordination to Mombasa port
Step 4: Customs clearance for project cargo
Step 5: Specialized heavy transport to site
Step 6: On-site delivery and installation support

blocks.title: Project logistics questions
items:
What is project logistics? 
Project logistics involves planning and coordinating the movement of heavy, oversized or operationally complex cargo that requires special handling, route review, timing control and delivery planning for large-scale developments like mining, energy and infrastructure projects.

What types of cargo can Kenya Tradex support under project logistics? 
Kenya Tradex supports project logistics for heavy equipment (20-200+ tons), oversized machinery, mining crushers and excavators, wind turbine components, oil and gas infrastructure, transformers, generators, industrial presses, and complete plant relocation.

Do you support project cargo moving beyond Kenya? 
Yes. Kenya Tradex supports project cargo planning for regional delivery into Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Tanzania — including major project sites like Turkana (oil fields), Hoima (Uganda oil), Lake Kivu (methane gas), and Lubumbashi (copper/cobalt mining).
